item.title: Front Matter URL Tokens
item.description: This page is stored below content/en/hugo-131-url-tokens/, but its section cascade renders it at /hugo-131/front-matter-url-token-demo/. The example keeps the content local and deterministic while exercising the theme’s list links, breadcrumbs, canonical URLs, and processed eyecatch image output.
